summary: Phase E item 3 (Marketplace Packages) fully verified on shared backend, web (RadioLife overlay) and mobile (Expo). 19/19 backend pytest cases pass covering merchant CRUD (list w/ sold_count, create/update/delete, 404 package_not_found on unknown, 422 credits<1), consumer flows (business_packages w/ items+mine+points_balance+points_per_dollar=100, business_detail.has_packages=true, points purchase success + insufficient_points, card purchase returns stripe checkout_url/cs_ session_id, purchase status pending/paid, purchase_not_found 404, unknown package 404, bad_method 400), packages/mine, and redeem engine (decrement, no_credits when depleted, 404 unknown). Web UI: /shop/merchant/packages (rl-merchant-packages-page + all mpkg-* form testIDs) create+delete flow works end-to-end via UI; /shop/packages/biz_8484f6f985d5 shows pkg-product-*, pkg-buy-card-*, pkg-buy-points-*, pkg-mine + 2 pkg-mine-* + 2 pkg-redeem-* buttons. Entry links merchant-open-packages (merchant dashboard) and shop-detail-package (business detail) both render on web. Mobile parity confirmed: mpkg-root + all form testIDs and mpkg-item render on /merchant/packages; pkg-root + product/buy-card/buy-points + pkg-mine + redeem all render on /shop/packages/[id]; merchant-open-packages on /merchant/dashboard; shop-detail-package on /shop/[id]. No critical or minor bugs detected. Full parity across web+mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: purchase_package hardcodes currency='usd'; consider deriving from business/market for internationalization (same pattern as memberships/giftcards)
purchase_status route retrieves Stripe session on every poll — no rate-limit guard; ok for now but a burst of client polling could hit Stripe QPS limits

redeem endpoint does not enforce that pkg belongs to the SAME business as any context (server just trusts pkg.business_id) — currently no cross-business concern, but if 'redeem at venue' verification is added later, ensure it checks caller identity vs venue
package_products.list_packages issues N+1 count_documents (one per product) for sold_count — fine at current scale, aggregate later if merchants add many packages
test_credentials: Web: POST /api/auth/demo cookie (demo@bigfm.dubai). Mobile: demo-login-btn on /login.
seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete throwaway TEST_pkg_* package products against demo's biz_8484f6f985d5; the session-scoped fixture cleans up. Points purchase of the cheap TEST package (500 cents=500 pts) will decrement demo balance; card purchases leave a `pending` package_purchases row in Mongo (session unpaid, not activated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Packages phase is stable end-to-end. Backend redeem/decrement/used_up/no_credits engine, points/card purchase, and all entry links are in place on both surfaces. Note: (1) demo points balance drifts down as tests run — repeated runs may eventually trip insufficient_points on the cheap TEST purchase test; that branch is guarded with pytest.skip(). (2) test_marketplace_packages.py::TestConsumer::_active_purchase_id is a class-attribute cache — pytest re-orders by name so it happens to work; if you refactor, pass via fixture instead. (3) Next phases per PRD: Events, Multi-Merchant Cart.
